target.title: Support chunked uploads without Content-Length
target.description: Servers that don't set wsgi.input_terminated still send chunked bodies, and returning an empty stream silently drops them. Pass the stream through instead.

Title: Support chunked uploads without Content-Length

Description:
Servers that don't set wsgi.input_terminated still send chunked bodies, and returning an empty stream silently drops them. Pass the stream through instead.

</untrusted-pr-7e5f0dfcc521>

   143  def get_input_stream(
   144      environ: WSGIEnvironment,
   145      safe_fallback: bool = True,
   146      max_content_length: int | None = None,
   147  ) -> t.IO[bytes]:
   148      """Return the WSGI input stream, wrapped so that it may be read safely
   149      without going past the ``Content-Length`` header value or
   150      ``max_content_length``. This must be used to pass a safe stream to other
   151      functions, which are not responsible for enforcing this limit.
   152  
   153      If ``Content-Length`` exceeds ``max_content_length``, a
   154      :exc:`RequestEntityTooLarge`` ``413 Content Too Large`` error is raised.
   155  
   156      If the WSGI server sets ``environ["wsgi.input_terminated"]``, it indicates that the
   157      server handles terminating the stream, so it is safe to read directly. For example,
   158      a server that knows how to handle chunked requests safely would set this.
   159  
   160      If ``max_content_length`` is set, it can be enforced on streams if
   161      ``wsgi.input_terminated`` is set. Otherwise, an empty stream is returned unless the
   162      user explicitly disables this safe fallback.
   163  
   164      If the limit is reached before the underlying stream is exhausted (such as a file
   165      that is too large, or an infinite stream), the remaining contents of the stream
   166      cannot be read safely. Depending on how the server handles this, clients may show a
   167      "connection reset" failure instead of seeing the 413 response.
   168  
   169      :param environ: The WSGI environ containing the stream.
</untrusted-read_file-410be512cf2c>
